source_pass_rule: At least one pre-2025 historical Deribit BTC options response must be returned with executable bid/ask prices and sizes, with no strategy outcomes opened.
payment_block_rule: If route/schema/x402 are proven but historical payload requires payment or API key not separately authorized, classify SOURCE_PAYMENT_ACCESS_REQUIRED_COVERAGE_UNPROVEN.
schema_fail_rule: If historical endpoint lacks bid_price, ask_price, bid_size or ask_size, or lacks a historical time selector, classify SOURCE_SCHEMA_INSUFFICIENT.
